notes.title: Bumble Brawlers Update! 🛠️
notes.notes:
We’ve got a fresh update rolling out with some important fixes and a brand-new menu! Check out what’s new:

✅ Fixed: Plus/minus icons for stat changes in the item shop now display properly on the right-hand side.
🛍️ New Feature: Added a menu where you can view your current items and gear at a glance!

Jump in and check out the improvements! As always, let us know what you think, and keep brawling! 💥🐝

notes.title: Patch Notes – Latest Update!
notes.notes:
Hello Bumble Brawlers!

I pushed out a new update that should help a lot with the overall experience for you while you play the game.


 No More Game-Breaking Store Glitch! – Pausing while shopping no longer sends your game into the abyss. Feel free to browse without fear!
 Fewer Chest Monsters! – We love surprises, but not too many. Expect a more balanced dungeon experience.
 Better Item Comparison! – Stats now have individual plus/minus icons, making it much easier to see if you're upgrading or downgrading at a glance.
 Polytown Looks Better Than Ever! – The screenshot now properly reflects the new bridge, because details matter.

Enjoy the update, and happy adventuring! 🚀🔥
